explication: Cockpit is a browser-based Linux administration interface. A sysadmin connects to the web service, authenticates, and receives a shell session whose router dispatches pages for storage, networking, services, users, applications, metrics, and recovery/security tasks. Those pages use the JavaScript client and bridge channels to invoke operating-system services, D-Bus APIs, package backends, or remote SSH hosts; results and progress return to the browser. The sampled excerpts directly show web-server startup, storage and network initialization, package-manager selection, and application installation.
